svg.text: A clip-on mic and a road camera feed a Raspberry Pi in the car. Arc models turn sound, speech and video into events; the director decides what matters; the phone shows it and Dashy speaks.
hears the driver, passengers and the road
Dashy's voice plays on the phone / car audio
Makes its own Wi-Fi hotspot for the phone.
Server: live events, voice clips, camera frames
rules + a learned model (DD) on one clock · follow-ups: remind, call, calendar, navigate
Camera + sound + speech agree → stronger alert · one signal alone → gentle check-in
Learned model runs in shadow mode next to the rules; DD2 adds the road camera.
Dashy's voice, on the Pi: first audio in ~0.1 s, tone matched to urgency
Urgent screen: “I'm okay” or call your contact
Camera button: live view (glance while moving)
